clauses.clause: Reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.)
clauses.evidence: Trace shows only 'keywords +REACH' ([cast], Static); no flyer ever attacks it. Pack canopy_spider_reach_blocks_flyer (PASS): on seat 1's turn a 2/2 flying Drake attacks; the Spider's block ask is '<drake>,NONE', it blocks (blocked drake=[spider]), damage spider 2 / drake 1, seat 0 stays at 20; a 2/2 Bear without reach is never asked to block. Fails against a no-block expectation.
